evals.name: create-timing-analysis-skill
evals.prompt: I want to create a new Vivado skill for analyzing setup/hold violations after route_design. It should parse report_timing_summary, identify the worst paths, and generate a REPORT.md with fix recommendations. Help me create the SKILL.md.
evals.expected_output: Agent interviews for intent, uses the Vivado skill template, produces a SKILL.md with all required sections (Prerequisites, Workflow, Tcl Commands, Report Template, etc.), and validates against the checklist.

assertions.name: template_followed
assertions.description: Generated SKILL.md follows the Vivado skill template structure
assertions.check: Output SKILL.md has frontmatter (name, description), Prerequisites, Workflow steps, Discovery/Analysis/Fix phases, Report Template, and Efficiency Guidelines

assertions.name: tcl_commands_specified
assertions.description: Specific Vivado Tcl commands are listed in the skill
assertions.check: SKILL.md references report_timing_summary, get_timing_paths, and related Tcl commands

assertions.name: checklist_validated
assertions.check: Agent ran through the 12-point checklist and confirmed compliance

assertions.name: actual_names_mandate
assertions.check: SKILL.md contains Design-Specific Fix Rules or equivalent section mandating actual cell/net/clock names

evals.name: review-existing-skill
evals.prompt: Can you review my existing clock-domain-crossing-review skill against best practices? Here's the SKILL.md — tell me what's missing or needs improvement.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the skill, runs it through the 12-point checklist, identifies gaps (missing sections, pattern violations), and provides specific improvement recommendations.

assertions.name: checklist_applied
assertions.check: Agent checked: efficiency guidelines, session_id, sequential execution, actual names, action-before-narration, workspace detection, report template, Tcl correctness, error handling, edge cases, description trigger words, file organization

assertions.name: specific_feedback
assertions.description: Feedback is specific with line references
assertions.check: Review output references specific sections or lines in the SKILL.md that need changes

assertions.name: improvements_actionable
assertions.description: Improvement suggestions are actionable, not vague
assertions.check: Each suggestion includes what to change and example text or structure

evals.name: improve-skill-description
evals.prompt: My custom-drc-ep skill isn't triggering when users say 'run DRC checks on my emulation design'. Can you optimize the description for better trigger accuracy?
evals.expected_output: Agent analyzes the current description, identifies missing trigger phrases, tests against example prompts, and generates an improved description with better keyword coverage.

assertions.name: trigger_phrases_expanded
assertions.description: Description was expanded with more trigger phrases
assertions.check: New description includes additional trigger phrases like 'DRC', 'design rule', 'emulation', 'prototyping', 'EP checks'

assertions.name: description_format_correct
assertions.check: Description uses 'Use when...' pattern with multiple trigger phrase variants
